notes.title: Weekly report for MonGirl Conquest v0.5
notes.content:
Hello!

Artists started working on their tasks. We plan to add a new girl, young snow owl and 2 new H scenes in the upcoming v0.5 update. One for the new girl and another one for snow wolf mommy.

The main artist is on her break for the current month, but we are planning to add a new activity for mongirl interaction once she returns. While we are still thinking about the details, the main idea is to add mini-stories to seduced girls. The main idea at the moment is a small story arc with a quest or a puzzle ending with something special. There’s a possibility that with Eve’s help, this special something could be a striptease scene or a minigame. Based on the support and workload, we’ll see how the “pilot” try will go and gather feedback before proceeding with this idea.

This time, I decided to focus on the main quest first. Yoshi helped a lot to establish the contact with the snow tribe, but there’s always something not going according to the plan. What will it be this time? Check out yourself once the update will roll out!

Don’t forget to participate in the feedback poll. As I previously mentioned in earlier reports, we are gathering feedback for the new seduction event. The results will show us if there’s a sense in pursuing the new version of the seduction minigame over the current one. I’ll make a separate info post with the results once the poll will end.

Fixed snow hare’s sprite. Now it doesn’t have a part of her hood on her less clothed variation.

As always, if you don’t like something about the game – tell me, and if you like it – tell your friends ^^

notes.title: MonGirl Conquest v0.4.5 is live!
notes.content:
Mongirl Conquest v0.4.5 is up for download! Yoshi decides to help you out with contacting the snow tribe. She has some connection there, and it looks like everything will go smoothly. Right? I mean it’s Yoshi...

H content

MonGirl Conquest v0.4.5 has 3 new scenes. Young werewolf got a missionary scene. You can check it out here. The new girl, snow leopard mommy gets her first doggy H scene. Here’s the preview. And mommy pharaoh gets her missionary H scene. Here’s the preview.

New features and activities

There’s a new girl in v0.4.5 version. You can meet snow leopard mommy in the snowy exploration zone. Check out the red encounter orbs or use magic lamps from exploration/altar quests to create these encounters yourself. 

Aside from the main quest update, Cordelia got a new step in her optional adventure. You’ll get to see both deep caves filled with lava and magic crystal grotto where Cordelia’s tribe lives. Will the mermaid council agree to work with humans based on Cordelia’s experience? See it yourself!

Once you establish contact with the snow tribe, you’ll enter a special zone with a puzzle. If you want to get 100% completion – don’t miss on the puzzle section there. Don’t worry, it’s an easy one! 

Updated all anal scenes with a better motion for the 3rd phase. All girls received this tune-up. There’s no need to re-seduce them. The updated scene is available to all players who unlocked it before via usual means.

Small fixes and improvements

Fixed a problem with some seduction skills remaining in a player’s skill list after the encounter was over. No need to do anything on your side after the upcoming update. Extra skills will disappear on their own before any encounter after the next update arrives.

Fixed a bug that could start 2 H scenes at the same time and cause a crash. No action needed on the player’s side.
 
Fixed a mismatch between Cordelia’s dialogue sprite and her portrait in some dialogue scenes.

Adjusted the exit trigger on the optional zone where you fight the golem miniboss. Now, the exit trigger properly reacts to both walking over the exit point and clicking/tapping on it.

Fixed a bug that started a home date with snow bunny mommy instead of polar fox mommy. Now, you can initiate it correctly along with the H scene.

Slimmed up some of the old animations to speed up Spine animation loading times for low-end platforms.


As always, if you don’t like something about the game – tell me, and if you like MonGirl Conquest – tell your friends ^^

notes.title: MonGirl Conquest v0.4 is live!
notes.content:
Mongirl Conquest v0.4 is up for download! Finally, you’ll meet one of the native hunters for real. Though her intentions may differ yours. Either way, the stalemate is broken, and with Yoshi’s help everything will be fine, right? Right? Well, if nothing else you’ll see Cat’s cute side.

H content

MonGirl Conquest v0.4 has 3 new scenes. Young Jackal gets a new BJ scene. You can check it out here. The new girl, snow fox mommy gets her first H scene - cowgirl. Here’s the preview. And young bear from the first zone gets her anal H scene. Here’s the preview.

New features and activities

Two new girls arrive in v0.4 version. You can meet snow fox mommy in the snowy exploration zone. Check out the blue encounter orbs or use magic lamps to create these yourself. Don’t forget to wear something warm – her magic is pretty cold! The second one is octo-pirate Kallista. She’ll play a role in Cordelia’s quest.

As for Cordelia’s new adventure, you’ll help her track down and scout out a pirate ship. After a bit of stealth action, you’ll find out what are these scoundrels after and even get to talk with the pirate’s leader – Kallista. What will come of it? See for yourself!

Here’s a preview for the new seduction test event. The new approach is all about direct interaction instead of going for the list of skills during seduction events. Now, you can just click on an active zone and see the girl’s reaction. There’s a hint button that will toggle active zones directly. Aside from this, the seduction points logic is the same.

It’s up in a test mode behind your house. You can activate it if you seduced a bear girl in a normal way. I didn’t replace the old encounter with her so players could check out how the new encounter feels compared to the old one and provide feedback. The old encounter will stay as is for the time being. After gathering all the feedback, we’ll see how it will go.

Small fixes and improvements

Fixed a bug with the door puzzle where the “hint” room with the orb started out in the activated state, and the player couldn’t see the color change on the cloth. If you had any problems with the puzzle – most likely this was the cause. Sorry about that!

Added a proper green forest background to anal scenes during evening dates from “call a girl” option during the sleep prep.

Moved the option/text block to the left side of the screen for all variations of anal scene. This way it takes the space with little to no action during the scene.

Got some reports on animation stuttering and just going slow on machines that use integrated graphics. To be honest, not sure I even can do something about it due to the way how Spine plugin plays the animations, but I made a pass of slimming up some animation texture atlases. Some players reported that this helped them before. Perhaps it will do the trick again. Anyway, if you get any problems with animated scenes – contact me with details in any way convenient for you. For example, via yeehawgames@gmail.com


As always, if you don’t like something about the game – tell me, and if you like MonGirl Conquest – tell your friends ^^

notes.title: MonGirl Conquest v0.3.5 is live!
notes.content:
Mongirl Conquest v0.3.5 is up for download! This time, you’ll be able to get deeper into the snowy island and meet new... Friends, yeah. How it’ll go? Check it out yourself!

H content

MonGirl Conquest v0.3.5 has 3 new scenes. Jackal mommy gets her new missionary scene. You can check it out in this post. New girl, snow hare mommy gets her first H scene - titfuck. Here’s the preview. And polar wolf mommy gets a new type of scene - anal. Here’s the preview. We’ll add more variety to the scenes in the future updates.

New features and activities

One new girl arrives in v0.3.5 version. You can meet snow hare mommy in the snowy exploration zone. Check out the red encounter orbs or use magic lamps to create these yourself.

I’ll get a chance to solve an extra puzzle after venturing to the snow island for the second time. The new puzzle uses a new mechanic and depends on the “point of view” logic. It’s optional, so don’t forget that you can skip it if you’ll encounter problems.

Aside from this, Cordelia’s quest original author finished the narrative part for Cordelia’s titfuck scene. It started out as animation only, but v0.3.5 will introduce the narrative part. If you already finished the current step in her quest, you can check out the new narrative option for her scene via the gallery.

The new seduction event for young bear is mostly done from the logic perspective. It’s already in the game as a test event, but we need to polish the animations via the artist who worked with it. Since he’s on the new girl + her scene, this became a bottleneck for rolling it out. But it should appear in the upcoming update since the artist will start working on the fix before his new scene art pack.

Some players asked about the bar character sprites, and why there are no new additions. That’s because there’s a finite space for images swaps for all events and we hit that limit. At the moment, there’s no way to add another pack of sprites for new girls. I’m not sure if there’s a proper way to extend the limit, so we’ll need to sidestep this issue in the future after inventing a way to do this.

Small fixes and improvements

Improved titfuck scene finishing animation for all girls who have this type of scene.

Fixed a bug that counted Earth elemental mommy as a rare girl for exploration quests if the player used a master gem to skip the seduction minigame.

Fixed some typos and inconsistences in dialogues.

Changed activation lines for Cordelia’s skills in the combo adventure with her.


As always, if you don’t like something about the game – tell me, and if you like MonGirl Conquest – tell your friends ^^

notes.title: MonGirl Conquest v0.3 is live!
notes.content:
Mongirl Conquest v0.3 is up for download! This time, you will set foot on the new island and try to contact the biggest local tribe. How it’ll go? Let’s see what’s new aside from the usual story update.

H content

MonGirl Conquest v0.3 has 3 new scenes. Young fennec gets her new missionary scene. You can check it out in this post. New girl, polar wolf mommy, gets her first H scene - cowgirl. Here’s the preview. Another new girl, earth elemental mommy, gets a missionary scene. Here’s the preview.

You can encounter earth elemental and polar wolf in the new, snowy exploration zone. Fennec can be encountered both in desert and snowy zones. Some girls will have to act as stand-ins until we’ll get enough new girls to fully populate the new exploration area. I’ll gradually phase out these stand-ins with each upcoming update and new girl.

New features and activities

Three new girls arrive in v0.3 version. You can check out polar wolf mommy here. Earth elemental mommy awaits you here. And the young polar fox hides here. First two can be encountered in the new exploration zone, while Mila the cute fox is a new plot character.

Added a new exploration zone. This time, it’s a pretty cold place. So, don’t forget to get some warm clothes. Otherwise, some encounter effects will have a stronger effect on you. Also, the snowy exploration zone is a bit different from the previous ones graphics-wise. It’s more about quality of life changes, like swapping active blinking markers from yellow-white to red-ish colors. Otherwise, these are hard to see on the snowy landscape. Plus, the “islands” you explore use different types of terrain and encounter backgrounds. Based on your feedback, I’m open to fine-tuning these elements.

Added a pair of new weapons to the smithy in your camp for fighters and mages. It’s a part of an already existing smithy upgrade that you could buy a bit earlier, so you don’t need to visit the quartermaster. Though, these new weapons will require a new material from the snow exploration zone.

Added two new weapons (one for mages and one for hunters) to the snowy zone hunter’s altar. You can buy them with shards you get for completing the dynamic quests during exploration. Fighter’s weapon allows 2 basic attacks during a turn. Mage’s weapon offers solid mana regen.

Small fixes and improvements

Changed the look of the seduction bar during seduction encounters or dates. Now, it has a proper sprite assigned instead of a basic bar.

Fixed a problem that prevented some girls from playing the stripping animation effect during their “phase” transitions in encounters.

Optimized the loading for some H scenes. Hopefully, this will help with loading times on weaker devices.

Fixed a few typos here and there based on player feedback.

Fixed a visual bug that shown an incorrect amount of unlocked scenes in the gallery. This doesn’t affect your H scenes, just save information on the loading screen.

Fixed a bug that prevented passive camp upgrades from providing materials.

Fixed a bug that caused loading for graphical assets to hang and just keep the “loading” picture over everything else in the evening dates.

Fixed a rare bug that caused a black screen after a scene to remain there indefinitely.

Fixed a bug that caused a background to be placed on a wrong layer, hiding the H scene behind the backdrop in some scenarios.


As always, if you don’t like something about the game – tell me, and if you like MonGirl Conquest – tell your friends ^^

notes.title: Weekly report for MonGirl Conquest v0.3
notes.content:
Hello!

Artists are finishing their tasks. So, we are aiming for 3 new girls in the upcoming v0.3 update. Namely, young polar fox, mommy earth elemental, and mommy polar woof. Planned new scenes aren’t set in stone except for fennec and her missionary H scene. We are aiming for 2 more, but the artists working on these prefer to finish the girl design first, and then pick an H scene. I’ll provide more info once they are ready.

I’m working on the new step in the main quest where you will do the first landing on the snowy island and have a bit of a problem with locals. This time, both Cat and Cleo will accompany you for the better security. How will it play out? You’ll see in the upcoming update.

The new main quest is around 30% completion. The narrative is finished. I’m working on new maps, tilesets and scripting it all into a draft version for playtesting. Since the action will involve both snowy zones and some of the old ones, maps are the main time-eater here. Anyway, we are aiming for the usual release window of February 14th-16th for the MonGirl Conquest v0.3.

The new exploration zone is almost done. You’ll unlock it after starting the new step of the main quest. I just need to tune the resources and assign stand-in girls. Just as we did before, some girls will have to step up to increase the pool of girl encounters for the new island. Then, once we get more new girls, these will be phased out in favor of newcomers. So, in short, the same thing we did with the second island. Most players are already familiar with this approach, but it won’t hurt to mention it for the newcomers.

Also, the snowy exploration zone will be a bit different from the previous ones graphics-wise. It’s more about quality of life changes, like swapping active blinking markers from yellow-white to red-ish colors. Otherwise, these are hard to see on the snowy landscape. Based on your feedback, I’m open to fine-tuning these elements later.

Added a pair of new weapons to the smithy in your camp for fighters and mages. It’s a part of an already existing smithy upgrade that you could buy a bit earlier, so you don’t need to visit the quartermaster. Though, these new weapons will require a new material from the snow exploration zone.

Fixed a bug that caused loading for graphical assets to hang and just keep the “loading” picture over everything else in the evening dates.

Fixed a few typos here and there based on player feedback.

Fixed a rare bug that caused a black screen after a scene to remain there indefinitely.

Also, don’t forget to participate in the active “next girl” poll for the upcoming winter zone. The winner will join the monster girl roster in future updates.


As always, if you don’t like something about the game – tell me, and if you like it – tell your friends ^^

notes.title: MonGirl Conquest v0.2.8 release and full changelog
notes.content:
Mongirl Conquest v0.2.8 is up for download! Queen Adia wants to hold a special lesson for you and she won’t take no for an answer. Let’s see what’s new aside from the usual story update.

H content

MonGirl Conquest v0.2.8 has 3 new scenes. Tongue-twister gets her new missionary. You can check it out in this post. Queen Adia get her new cowgirl H scene. Here’s the preview. And finally, Cordelia gets her titfuck/paizuri scene. You can see it here.

Cordelia’s scene posed a new kind of challenge with the dynamic background since she’s a mermaid, and we can’t just pull her out completely from the water. At least not now. Plus we decided to test out an idle “after scene” animation. This puts extra strain on the animation plugin, but test runs gave us no problems on different hardware and software combos we had available. Still, if you encounter performance issues during her scene – contact me with details via yeehawgames@gmail.com.

Also, Cordelia’s scene will start out as animation only and will get the narrative variation later. Her original author didn’t have the time to finish the text part for the scene before the release date, but you can expect it to pop up in the next one.

New features and activities

Cordelia gets the third step in seaside cave journey with some optional content. This time you’ll get to fight along the mermaid. Thankfully, her water magic is just the thing you need to overcome all problems and get the ultimate reward – mermtits! I mean you’ll get a choice of several magic items too, but we all know why we are helping the fishy.

There’s an optional branch with a puzzle and special combat encounter for 100% clear fans. You don’t need to rush it in one go, though. You can return to this cave after leaving by interacting with Cordelia’s usual spot during evening. So, take it in your own pace.

A new girl joins the cast. Namely, earth elemental. She won’t appear immediately, but in the new winter zone that will be open for exploration in the next update.

Added a new set of clothes with defensive skill that improves both normal and magical defense at the same time. If you have trouble figuring out boss patterns (like with the golem), it will help to mitigate incoming damage.

Added a new sound pack for titfuck scenes. After some polishing and playtesting, it will be in all titfuck encounters in the game instead of the placeholder for doggy/missionary sex. It includes a new ending sequence too.

Small fixes and improvements

Fixed a specific error if the player tried to exit the desktop version of the game via the main menu.
Some minor spelling corrections for dialogues and journal entries.

Fixed a bug that displayed a black screen instead of a scene in some cases when you started them in your house via evening dates. If you still get this effect – contact me with details.
Adjusted some map geometry to improve character pathing.

Fixed a possibility for Queen Adia’s titfuck scene to loop around for the second playthrough instead of ending properly.

As always, if you don’t like something about the game – tell me, and if you like MonGirl Conquest – tell your friends ^^
